body.statement: For each selected dual-tight row \(z\), repaired row \(z'\), and displacements \(\delta_a=z'_a-z_a\), the dual slack equals \( (\sum_a\delta_a)^2-\sum_a\delta_a^2+\sum_a[\phi_a(z'_a)-\phi_a(z_a)-g_a\delta_a]\). Summed over all rows produced by \(\mathsf A_{\mathrm{round}}\), this identity and the hierarchical movement bounds give \(N[C_{\mathrm{alg}}(F)-V_{\mathrm{rel}}(F)]\le9\sum_{\ell\ge0}h_\ell^2R_{\ell+1}<3456\).
body.justification: The exact slack identity removes the logarithm that a generic bounded-cost or Lipschitz repair argument would accumulate across scales.
body.gap: No cited Monge, mixability, or multi-marginal transport rounding result charges same-marginal integer repair by a dual Bregman remainder for this signed rank-one quadratic cost.
body.consumer: The identity delivers the explicit universal constant in the constructive upper theorem.
body.proof_tex:
Consider one frozen support row \(z=(z_1,z_2,z_3)\in E\), its repaired row \(z'=z+\delta\), and define
\[
 S=\sum_a z_a,\quad D=\sum_a\delta_a,\quad
 g_a=-2\sum_{b\ne a}z_b=-2(S-z_a)\in G_a(z_a).
\]
Dual tightness at \(z\) says \(S^2=\sum_a u_a(z_a)\), and \(u_a(r)=r^2-\phi_a(r)\).  Direct expansion therefore gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
 C(z')-\sum_a u_a(z'_a)
 &= (S+D)^2-\sum_a(z_a+\delta_a)^2+\sum_a\phi_a(z'_a)\\
 &=D^2-\sum_a\delta_a^2
   +\sum_a\{\phi_a(z'_a)-\phi_a(z_a)-g_a\delta_a\}.
\end{aligned}
\]
This is the asserted exact identity.  Cauchy--Schwarz gives
\[
 D^2-\sum_a\delta_a^2\le 2\sum_a\delta_a^2.
\]
If a nonzero arm-\(a\) movement has lowest common partition block at depth \(\ell\), that block is nonsingleton and both atom intervals lie in one dyadic cell of width \(h_\ell\).  Lem:ordered-dual-slopes, applied with the actual support slope \(g_a\), gives
\[
 \delta_a^2\le h_\ell^2,\quad
 0\le\phi_a(z'_a)-\phi_a(z_a)-g_a\delta_a\le h_\ell^2.
\]
Thus the contribution of that coordinate to the upper bound is at most \(3h_\ell^2\); a singleton or unmoved coordinate contributes zero.

Sum over all \(N\) rows.  Repair preserves every marginal multiplicity, so
\[
 \sum_{\text{rows}}\sum_a u_a(z'_a)
 =\sum_{a,s}b_{as}u_{as}
 =N V_{\mathrm{rel}}(F),
\]
where the last equality is dual optimality for \(q^\star=N\pi^\star\).  Lem:hierarchical-repair then yields
\[
\begin{aligned}
 N\{C_{\mathrm{alg}}(F)-V_{\mathrm{rel}}(F)\}
 &\le 3\sum_{a=1}^3\sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}h_\ell^2M_{a,\ell}\\
 &\le 9\sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}h_\ell^2R_{\ell+1}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(R_{\ell+1}<24/h_{\ell+1}=48/h_\ell\),
\[
 9\sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}h_\ell^2R_{\ell+1}
 <432\sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1}h_\ell
 <432\sum_{\ell=0}^{\infty}4\,2^{-\ell}
 =3456.
\]
If \(L=0\), there is no movement and the sums are empty.  This proves the claimed accounting and its strict universal bound.
